outcomes.name: change in the integrated Alzheimer’s Disease Rating Scale (iADRS) score from baseline to 76 weeks
outcomes.quote: Patients treated with KISUNLA demonstrated a statistically significant reduction in clinical decline on iADRS compared to placebo at Week 76 in the combined population (2.92, p<0.0001) and the low/medium tau population (3.25, p<0.0001).
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: The primary efficacy endpoint was change in the integrated Alzheimer’s Disease Rating Scale (iADRS) score from baseline to 76 weeks.

outcomes.name: Clinical Dementia Rating Scale – Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB)
outcomes.quote: Patients treated with KISUNLA demonstrated a statistically significant reduction in clinical decline on CDR-SB compared to placebo at Week 76 in the combined population (-0.70, p<0.0001)
outcomes.prespecification_evidence: Other efficacy endpoints included Clinical Dementia Rating Scale – Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB), ADAS-Cog13, and ADCS-iADL.
